title: Monotonicity outside an interval
statement: Let $\mu,\mu'$ be integer-valued sequences and let $a,n,a',n'$ be natural numbers. Suppose they agree at every index less than $a$ or at least $a+n$, with $a'\le a$ and $a+n\le a'+n'$. Then they agree at every index less than $a'$ or at least $a'+n'$.
hypotheses_covered: Agreement at every index $b<a$ or $a+n\le b$
